commits_data.title: MP-DCCP:  Solving Compilation Errors on Certain Compilers
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP:  Solving Compilation Errors on Certain Compilers

-Changed the encoding of certain options to their appropriate value, the old values caused compilation error on some machines
-Reverted change #1 in commit c7d3335110290886f6dd56fa640c8b0ca0b7fce5 which caused a packet malformation error due to a data item being read incorrectly.

commits_data.title: MP-DCCP: Solving Compilation Errors on Certain Compilers
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP: Solving Compilation Errors on Certain Compilers

-Certain lines had a mixture of tabs and spaces which prevented compilation on certain machines

commits_data.title: MP-DCCP: Solving Compilation Errors on Certain Compilers
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP: Solving Compilation Errors on Certain Compilers

-Certain lines had a mixture of tabs and spaces which prevented compilation on certain machines
-Replaced protocol abbreviation from mpdccp.mp_* to dccp_mp_* to solve PROTOABBREV error when building

commits_data.title: MP-DCCP: Resolved Minor Merge Issues
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP: Resolved Minor Merge Issues

-Changed proto_tree_add_unit to proto_tree_add_item, as suggested for the dissect feature option
-Changed conditional statements to switch case in for MP_ADDADDR

commits_data.title: MP-DCCP: Improved MP_CONFIRM
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP: Improved MP_CONFIRM
-MP_Confirm dissection now works as a recursive function, which is capable of more effectively dissect a list of incoming confirmations.

commits_data.title: MP-DCCP: Modified MP_CONFIRM to match IETF draft.
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP: Modified MP_CONFIRM to match IETF draft.

-List MP_OPT as a subtree with relevant MP_SEQ, ID Address and/or subflow. 
-Fixed a compilation warning due to an except statement creating subtree for an inexistent tree.

commits_data.title: Merge branch 'master' into 'master'
commits_data.message:
Merge branch 'master' into 'master'

MP-DCCP: Fix dissection of Feature options, rename multi-path suboptions to match specification, and include different sub-options values

See merge request GREGORIO-M/wireshark!1

commits_data.title: MP-DCCP: -Rename multi-path subobtions to match IETF draft.
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP: -Rename multi-path subobtions to match IETF draft.

-Add MP-KEY value.
-Add Key Data in MP_CLOSE.
-Add HMAC data.
-Correct IPv4 address endianess.

commits_data.title: DCCP: Fix dissection of Feature options to match feature_number names instead option_type, and include MP_CAPABLE feature.
commits_data.message: DCCP: Fix dissection of Feature options to match feature_number names instead option_type, and include MP_CAPABLE feature.

commits_data.title: MP-DCCP: Added all features to MP-DCCP V6.
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP: Added all features to MP-DCCP V6.

Previous implementation lacked MP_ADDADDR, MP_REMOVEADDR and had an outdated version of MP_PRIO.

Fixed a bug where the dissector had an incorrect offset of 1 byte, resulting in it incorrectly reading headers and data, something resulting in malformed packets.

commits_data.title: MP-DCCP: Implemented MP-DCCP up-to V4.
commits_data.message:
MP-DCCP: Implemented MP-DCCP up-to V4.

Used Leonard Walter's MP-DCCP dissector code.
